definitions.explanation: The act of providing necessary supplies, especially food, water, fuel, or other essential resources. Often used in military, logistics, and sports contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補給|ほきゅう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補給|ほきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

{補給|ほきゅう}{路|ろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{断|た}たれた→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{物資|ぶっし}→物資：07863_busshi⟧{不足|ぶそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}った→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: Because the supply line was cut, the frontline troops fell into a shortage of supplies.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in both everyday and specialized contexts. In daily life, most commonly heard as ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧{補給|ほきゅう} (hydration) and ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧{補給|ほきゅう} (nutrition replenishment). In military and logistics contexts, refers to supply lines and provisioning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧{補給|ほきゅう}: hydration, fluid replenishment
- ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧{補給|ほきゅう}: nutrition replenishment
- {補給|ほきゅう}{路|ろ}: supply route/line
- {補給|ほきゅう}⟦{基地|きち}→基地：03982_kichi⟧: supply base
- {補給|ほきゅう}⟦{物資|ぶっし}→物資：07863_busshi⟧: supplies, provisions
